Onboarding.introBody: Relay helps you find a med routine that works for you. You try small tests and earn XP as you go.
Onboarding.promiseBody: We never change your dose or meds. Dose questions go to your care team.
Onboarding.promiseNote: Relay helps with your routine: when, where, and who helps you.
Onboarding.privacyCare: Your care team sees your test results. This helps them help you.
Onboarding.privacyParent: You choose what your parent sees. You can change it any time.
Onboarding.tour_home: Log your meds and see your XP grow.
Onboarding.tour_meds: Learn what each med does for you.
Onboarding.tour_quests: Try small tests to find what works.
Onboarding.tour_me: Your settings, and who sees what.
Onboarding.barriersBody: Pick all that fit. There are no wrong answers.
Onboarding.barrier_embarrassed: I don't want others to see
Onboarding.barrier_feel: I don't like how they make me feel
Onboarding.otherLabel: Tell us in your own words
Onboarding.pickOne: Pick at least one to keep going.
Onboarding.remindersBody: Your care team set your med times. Pick a reminder time that fits your day.
Onboarding.doneBody: Now let's find what works for you.
